label: full_public_schedule_separate_verified_firefox_environment
command: cd /tmp/work && mkdir -p /tmp/work/node_modules && for entry in /app/node_modules/* /app/node_modules/.[!.]*; do case "${entry##*/}" in .vite|.vite-temp|.cache) ;; *) [ -e "$entry" ] && ln -s "$entry" /tmp/work/node_modules/ ;; esac; done; NODE_PATH=/app/node_modules /app/node_modules/.bin/mocha --reporter xunit --reporter-option output=/tmp/report.xml "$@"
